property_summary: For any active request and any lender, clearRequest creates a loan whose index equals the value later used as the approvals key: approving loan k must write the delegate at approvals[k] and nowhere else; the mutant writes approvals[loans.length] instead, so for any valid loanID the getter approvals(loanID) returns zero after approveTransfer.
change_summary: Use the length of the loans array as the mapping key instead of loanID_, so approvals is written at a different key.
